title: Interview: notifications
lead: Decide notification channels, recipients, ping times and quiet hours (X1-X2; ADR 0024).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** implementation; the conversation mailbox, Matrix, autonomy levels and commands (S61, ADR 0028).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Notifications should help without becoming noise, and a non-technical household member has to be OK with them. The conversation channels moved to S61 so the notifier (S42) does not wait on Matrix.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. Channel per person: ntfy (self-hosted? which server?), email, or both?
2. Which pings: tonight's dinner/defrost (what time?), the weekly planning reminder, runout warnings, use-it-up?
3. Quiet hours?
4. Where does ntfy run (an existing instance, or add one to compose)? Which SMTP sends the email pings, and which secret file holds its password?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Ask the questions, including a non-technical household member's preferences.
2. Write ADR 0024; record the raw answers in `local/` (not committed); update the notifier slice (S42).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - ADR 0024 lists each ping with its channel, recipient and time, and the quiet hours.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
